lesson.shape_friends.title: Shape Friends
lesson.shape_friends.summary: Practice a circle, square and triangle, combine them into a simple friend, then choose your own details.
lesson.shape_friends.step.circle: Start with a roomy circle. Travel all the way around until your line meets where it began.
lesson.shape_friends.help.circle: Go slowly around the curve. Your circle can be a little wobbly and still be yours.
lesson.shape_friends.complete.circle: Your circle came all the way around.
lesson.shape_friends.step.square: Next, draw a big square. Make four sides and turn at each corner.
lesson.shape_friends.help.square: Look for the next corner before you change direction.
lesson.shape_friends.complete.square: Four sides made one closed shape.
lesson.shape_friends.step.triangle: Now make a triangle with three long sides that meet.
lesson.shape_friends.help.triangle: Start at the top, travel to one bottom corner, across to the other, then back home.
lesson.shape_friends.complete.triangle: Three sides joined into a triangle.
lesson.shape_friends.step.build_friend: Let’s combine shapes: a circle for the head, a square body underneath, and a triangle hat on top.
lesson.shape_friends.help.build_friend: Notice where the shapes sit: head above body, hat above head. They do not need to touch exactly like mine.
lesson.shape_friends.complete.build_frie: You combined simple shapes into a character.
lesson.shape_friends.step.make_friend_yo: Eyes, smiles, arms and hat details are just ideas. Add any details you want—or invent different ones.
lesson.shape_friends.help.make_friend_yo: Ask what your friend likes, wears or carries. One small detail can give them a personality.
lesson.shape_friends.complete.drawing: Your shapes became a friend, and your choices made the character yours.
